title: Mizoram State Health Care Scheme (MSHCS) Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Government health protection scheme for eligible Mizoram residents and notified beneficiary groups.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility depends on Mizoram residency, enrolment and current state rules for covered beneficiaries.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Mizoram State Health Care Scheme (MSHCS).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
